The steps for a new VLAN and subnet that needs Internet access (Figure 22.16):
Choose a new VLAN and subnet (hopefully with an IP address management tool).
Make sure the VLAN exists on all switches (VTP can help).
Configure STP so the new VLAN has the right root switch.
Add the VLAN to trunk allow lists.
Create an SVI on each distribution switch, and use an FHRP.
Add the new subnet to the routing protocol.
Update firewall rules, and configure NAT.
Adjust external routing, depending on requirements.
Doing this often is slow and risky: it needs planning, change control, and clean-up when the VM is gone. This is the pain that a controller can automate.

What do users and scripts use to interact with an SDN controller?
B - the NBI, usually a GUI or REST API.
Which interface does the controller use to configure network devices?
The southbound interface - examples: OpenFlow, NETCONF, OpFlex.
A. Virtual tunnels that provide services
B. The physical Layer 3 network that gives connectivity
C. A name for all devices in the solution
B - the overlay is the tunnels. The fabric is the term for everything.
A virtual network tunnelled over the underlay, where services such as security and QoS are applied - VXLAN is the usual tunnel type.
A term for all the network devices that use the SDN solution (the underlay and overlay together) - the controller abstracts the details.
Which plane runs OSPF and ARP?
B - the control plane runs protocols and builds forwarding information.
Which plane includes SSH, SNMP, HTTPS and the console port?
The management plane - it is how you reach and manage the device.
Which plane forwards traffic and drops packets denied by an ACL?
The data plane - it does not run protocols.
Which protocol does an NMS mainly use to poll devices?
A - an NMS polls with SNMP.
What is the difference between an SNMP poll and a trap?
A poll is a request from the NMS. A trap is sent by the device on its own when an event happens - traps often carry more detail than syslog.
Which syslog severity number is "warnings", and which is "debugging"?
4 and 7 - 0 is emergencies and 7 is debugging. A setting of N sends N and lower numbers.
Which command points a router at a syslog server?
Name three things an NCM does.
Back up, compare, search and push configurations (any three) - templates are another.
Which table does CEF build from the routing table, and which table is built from ARP?
The FIB, and the adjacency table - both are in the data plane.
Which southbound protocol does OpenDaylight use, and which does Cisco ACI use?
OpenFlow and OpFlex - OpenFlow is imperative. OpFlex is declarative.
Which protocol uses XML over SSH, TCP port 830 by default?
A - RFC 6241 (Cisco IOS XE documentation). It models data with YANG.
In spine/leaf, which devices does a leaf connect to?
Every spine, and no other leaf - a leaf-to-leaf path is leaf, spine, leaf.
Why is STP a bad choice in an SDN underlay?
It blocks redundant links, wasting fast uplinks. Layer 3 links with ECMP use them all - use routed ports and OSPF instead.
No DR/BDR election is needed - the neighbour state shows FULL with a dash instead of a DR role.

Cisco DNA Center - Cisco's data sheet says "formerly Cisco DNA Center".

LAN Automation - a DHCP server on the upstream device gives the new device its address and the PnP server details.

No, only show commands - use Templates for configuration.

It shows the true path including tunnels, Layer 2 switches and ACLs that would block traffic - traceroute shows only Layer 3 hops.
